rule: Do not rewrite the fingerprinted authored Time Learning manuscript. This file defines how the existing authored content is taught, sequenced, evidenced and reported.

instructional_arc.title: Seeing Time
instructional_arc.concept: Time is spent, not lost; patterns can be observed without turning them into identity judgments.
45_minute_flow: 3m retrieval: where did yesterday's time go?
7m story/evidence: Lethabo's Saturday
10m explain: time as the space in which life happens; observation vs judgement
12m apply: name one real time moment and describe it as a pattern
5m pair: describe pattern without advice
5m capture: record/trace one piece of real evidence
3m bridge: bring the pattern and record tomorrow

instructional_arc.title: Thinking Like an Investigator
instructional_arc.concept: Memory is a story; a record is evidence. Observation and interpretation must be separated.
45_minute_flow: 3m retrieval: compare yesterday's prediction with evidence
7m case: Nosipho's week
10m explain: memory vs record; observation vs interpretation
12m apply: compare remembered day to actual record
5m pair: identify the interpretation hidden inside an observation
5m capture: observation + interpretation + alternative explanation
3m bridge: prepare for the Time Pause

instructional_arc.title: The Time Pause / Your Experiment Begins
instructional_arc.concept: A behavioural investigation needs a clear target condition, prediction, response method and evidence rule.
45_minute_flow: 3m retrieval: what makes evidence usable?
7m discover: identify the learner's target time pattern
10m explain: target condition, Time Pause, prediction and witness
12m apply: build the personal experiment and prediction
5m pair: test whether the target condition is observable
5m capture: baseline/confidence/prediction/experiment setup
3m handoff: begin the 7-day field experiment

instructional_arc.title: Understanding the Time Pattern
instructional_arc.concept: Triggers are bundles; time leaks are unnoticed time; feeling busy is not the same as being busy; behaviour can lead feeling.
45_minute_flow: 3m retrieval: what happened at the first eligible opportunity?
7m case: Myah's Tuesday
10m explain the four pattern concepts
12m apply: deepen the learner's own pattern map
5m pair: locate the leak and trigger bundle
5m capture: updated pattern/equation inputs
3m bridge: record evidence rather than impressions

instructional_arc.title: Evidence Studio
instructional_arc.concept: Evidence has rules: record close to the event, distinguish opportunity from day, and preserve 'no opportunity' and missing states.
45_minute_flow: 3m retrieval: classify yesterday's entry
7m case: Sipho's record vs memory
10m explain evidence quality and opportunity rules
12m apply: audit the learner's tracker
5m pair: classify evidence states
5m capture: clean tracker entry and evidence-quality state
3m bridge: continue field experiment

instructional_arc.title: Field Experiment
instructional_arc.concept: The concept must survive outside the classroom.
45_minute_flow: No classroom session
field requirement: complete honest opportunity-based tracking
field evidence: one record per eligible day, including no-opportunity/missing states
learner action: continue the agreed Time Pause without changing the goal

instructional_arc.title: Experiment Clinic
instructional_arc.concept: A barrier is information; repetition builds an alternative pattern; adjust the method, not the goal.
45_minute_flow: 3m retrieval: inspect the week without judging it
7m case: Lethabo's mixed week
10m explain barriers, repetition and calibration
12m apply: diagnose what helped/hindered
5m pair: distinguish goal change from method change
5m capture: adjustment and restart plan
3m bridge: complete the final field day cleanly

instructional_arc.title: Final Field Application
instructional_arc.concept: The final day must remain comparable; performance is not evidence.
45_minute_flow: 3m retrieval: what would make the final day invalid?
7m case: Nosipho's clean close
10m explain performance contamination and clean closure
12m apply: complete final evidence entry and inspect the whole week
5m pair: read the week as a whole
5m capture: seven-day evidence summary
3m bridge: prepare for evidence review

instructional_arc.title: Evidence Review
instructional_arc.concept: Read the tracker as evidence about attention allocation, not as a score of character.
45_minute_flow: 3m retrieval: classify evidence before calculating
7m case: Myah's reclaimed evening
10m explain Time Adherence, Prediction Accuracy and Reclaim Rate as descriptive measures
12m apply: calculate and interpret own results
5m pair: identify what changed and what did not
5m capture: pre/post evidence and evidence-confidence state
3m bridge: prepare transfer

instructional_arc.title: Transfer & Meta-Time
instructional_arc.concept: The time moment is the example; the investigation method is the transferable capability.
45_minute_flow: 3m retrieval: explain the method without naming the original problem
7m new-context prompt
10m explain transfer and meta-time
12m apply: map a second time pattern
5m pair: test whether the method transferred
5m capture: second-context application
3m bridge: final integration

instructional_arc.title: Integration & Next Bridge
instructional_arc.concept: The learner can now state what was investigated, what the evidence showed, where the pattern shifted, what capability was demonstrated and what comes next.
45_minute_flow: 3m retrieval: read the ten 'Right now I feel like someone who…' entries
8m explain: distinguish result, learning, competency and next action
10m apply: complete Time Investigation Profile
8m demonstrate: future-self letter / one-sentence identity shift
5m pair: explain the method to another person
8m evidence capture: portfolio, certificate and next pathway
3m close: one next real-world action

learning_attainment: Can explain the Time Pause and time-leak model
